candidates.statement: Checkout 502s trace to inventory's redis.reserve_inventory timing out (~2s) with DependencyUnavailable, propagating ReadTimeout through inventory and order to gateway /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side metrics/logs absent; timeout cause (saturation vs network) unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts in inventory cascading as ReadTimeouts through order to gateway /v1/checkout 502s; metrics show elevated checkout p95 (~2.4s) and 502s. Topology confirms gateway->order->inventory->redis path. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout.
missing_evidence: Redis dependency metrics (latency, errors, saturation) for inventory's redis to confirm timeout origin
Inventory service logs around 03:20-03:21 to corroborate redis timeout cause
